title: Finite-Tor restriction of ordinary site comparison
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a positive integer $n$, and let $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For any scheme $T$, let $P_e,P_p$ be the published finite-Tor constructible object predicates in the ordinary small etale and fixed-scalar pro-etale derived categories [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Let $F=\nu_T^*$ be the actual comparison. There is an equivalence $P_e\simeq P_p$ whose functor commutes with the full inclusions via $F$. For each bounded-below etale $K$ in $P_e$ and integers $a\le b$, its ordinary etale Tor amplitude is in $[a,b]$ if and only if $FK$ has ordinary pro-etale Tor amplitude in that same interval. Every $K$ in $P_p$ admits an etale $H$ in $P_e$ with $FH\cong K$.

proof.text: Apply finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin to the intrinsic realization of a fixed-scalar pro-etale object. Convert finite support of its homology to an ordered integer interval, using lower and upper bounds and min/max; this includes empty support. Full faithfulness of the derived realization cancels the realization and yields a fixed-scalar etale representative.

The existing unbounded fixed-scalar Tor-interval comparison and intrinsic Tor transport identify every ordered interval. Comparison therefore sends finite-Tor etale objects into the intrinsic finite-Tor predicate and reflects the interval of each etale representative.

Lift the comparison to the full finite-Tor subcategories. Its Hom maps are bijective by bounded-below full faithfulness of the fixed-module derived comparison (bijective_comparisonUpperStar_mapDerivedCategory_map); representatives make it essentially surjective. Turn this functor into its equivalence; its square with the full inclusions is the identity natural isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem boundary_finite_tor_comparison (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p) (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (T : Scheme.{u}) : letI : Finite (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n) := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E n hn let C := coefficients (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n) let Pe := WeilConjectures.finiteTorConstructibleEtale l E n hn T let Pp := WeilConjectures.finiteTorConstructibleProEtaleModule l E n hn T let F := comparison C T (∃ e : Pe.FullSubcategory ≌ Pp.FullSubcategory, Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ Pp.ι ≅ Pe.ι ⋙ F)) ∧ (∀ (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology C)), Pe K.obj → ∀ (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b → (Etale.DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n)) T a b K.obj ↔ ProEtale.DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn C T a b (F.obj K.obj))) ∧ (∀ K, Pp K → ∃ H, Pe H ∧ Nonempty (F.obj H ≅ K))
